question: Will the Armada Acquisition Corp. II / Evernorth business combination close on October 1 or 2, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Vote is Sept 30 at noon ET; the proxy requires the Cayman-to-Delaware domestication at least one business day before closing, and domestication needs the meeting's approval, so the earliest possible close is Oct 1 — the window covers the first two feasible closing days. Company says close 'shortly thereafter' and now guides Q4 2026, consistent with Oct 1. Crypto-treasury SPACs often close 1-3 business days after the vote. Risks: meeting adjournment (~20%), Nasdaq listing approval and the investor-contribution side of the deal (reportedly including XRP) slipping the close to Oct 5+, and 2026's failed crypto-treasury SPAC deals. The proxy gives no target closing date. ~0.8 x ~0.58 ≈ 0.46. No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market found.
